_comment: Fine-Grained Password Policies (PSO) applied by SetFineGrainedPasswordPolicies. Requires Domain Functional Level >= 2008. Subjects are SamAccountNames of GLOBAL SECURITY GROUPS (or users); a missing group is skipped with a warning. Durations use the .NET TimeSpan format [d.]hh:mm:ss. Lowest Precedence wins when several PSOs apply to the same account. MaxPasswordAge 0.00:00:00 = never expires. Values follow ANSSI (12+ characters standard, 15+ privileged, 25+ service accounts) and CIS lockout guidance (threshold 3, 15 min). Test lockout settings on admin accounts in a lab first.

PSOs.Name: PSO-Tier0-Admins
PSOs.Description: Tier 0 administrators: 16 characters, 24 passwords of history, lockout after 3 failures. Managed by ADHardened.

PSOs.Name: PSO-Tier1-Admins
PSOs.Description: Tier 1 and Tier 1 Legacy administrators: 15 characters. Managed by ADHardened.

PSOs.Name: PSO-Tier2-Admins
PSOs.Description: Tier 2 (helpdesk) administrators: 15 characters. Managed by ADHardened.

PSOs.Name: PSO-Service-Accounts
PSOs.Description: Service accounts: 25+ characters, no expiry, no lockout (a lockout would be a denial of service). Prefer gMSA. Managed by ADHardened.

PSOs.Name: PSO-Standard-Users
PSOs.Description: Standard users (Tier 2): 12 characters, lockout after 3 failures. Managed by ADHardened.
